title: And per se And
description: And per se And changes the design of the ampersand character.
body:
# And per se And
## Overview
**And per se And** completely overhauls the "Minecraft ampersand experience", taking the humble character from the uniform 5-pixel wide default font, to a more sophisticated and modern design inspired by the multitude of ampersand designs available on the World Wide Web.

This pack is perfect for those who believe that the default ampersand looks oddly squished and cluttered, as it elegantly fixes the issue by extending the ampersand character by **two** pixels to the right.

Additionally, this pack also freshens up all ampersand related characters to ensure the best possible experience for its users.

## Features
This pack changes the design of the following characters:
- **&** Ampersand (U+0026)
- **⅋** Turned Ampersand (U+214B)

## Misc

This pack is designed to be compatible with any other resource pack. Note that if you have other font packs installed (that affect the ampersand), this pack must be on the top for the effects to be applied.

Regardless, this is my first font pack that changes only a select handful of characters, so issues may still arise. Please report any that you find!
